programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Eliane Elias
programme.desc: There's no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil', seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards', and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards' in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist. In this concert broadcast, recorded live at the Philharmonie in Munich, Elias shows her distinctive and immediately recognizable musical style, which blends her Brazilian samba roots and her sensuous, alluring voice with her impressive instrumental bebop, jazz, classical, and compositional skills. She is an artist beyond category, and in this concert she performs with Jay Randall Anderson (bass) and Adam Nussbaum (drums).

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival. Performing at an event that had previously played host to many of their musical heroes inspired the band to produce one of their finest performances on a set list that stretched back to their eponymous debut album from 1977 and right up to their most recent releases. This is goodtime rocking blues and nobody does it better than George Thorogood & The Destroyers.

programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf (Fury), Gary Oldman (The Dark Knight), Jai Courtney (Suicide Squad) and Kate Mara (House of Cards) headline this gripping, post-apocalyptic thriller. Home bound from Afghanistan, Gabriel, a hard-nosed US marine whose instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, desperately searches for his estranged family. This pulse-pounding story delivers a hard-hitting message.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: The God Committee
programme.desc: Who lives, who dies? They decide. Three patients wait to see if they will live or die as a hospital committee decides to grant a life saving heart transplant to one of them. Years later the committee face the consequences of their decision. Starring Emmy Award winner Kelsey Grammer (Frasier) and Julia Stiles (Riviera), Janeane Garofalo (The Truth about Cats & Dogs) and Colman Domingo (Selma).

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: Drugs. Money. Greed. Death. When a drug bust goes horribly wrong, David (Bruce Willis - Die Hard) , a decorated cop, finds himself at the mercy of a drug cartel. As the violent gang seeks refuge on farmland they soon discover one man (Chad Michael Murray - Riverdale) with a deadly aim who stands between them and freedom. Welcome to the Killing Field.

France, 1942. Under Nazi control, the Allies have been pushed off and Hitlers victory is nearly absolute. In hiding, Jacques radio broadcasts a message of hope. programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Alex Dee
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album 'On the Road' the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Eliane Elias
programme.desc: There's no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil', seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards', and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards' in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist. In this concert broadcast, recorded live at the Philharmonie in Munich, Elias shows her distinctive and immediately recognizable musical style, which blends her Brazilian samba roots and her sensuous, alluring voice with her impressive instrumental bebop, jazz, classical, and compositional skills. She is an artist beyond category, and in this concert she performs with Jay Randall Anderson (bass) and Adam Nussbaum (drums).

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: AC/DC
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next To The Moon" and more.

programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival. Performing at an event that had previously played host to many of their musical heroes inspired the band to produce one of their finest performances on a set list that stretched back to their eponymous debut album from 1977 and right up to their most recent releases. This is goodtime rocking blues and nobody does it better than George Thorogood & The Destroyers.

programme.title: Corrupt
programme.desc: Hallie Jones era una contable forense para la oficina del fiscal des distrito hasta que su testimonio le costó la vida a un hombre inocente. Pero cuando el testigo clave de un importante caso de corrupción aparece muerto, el fiscal del distrito Frank Morries, pedirá ayuda a la única persona que puede resolver el caso: Hallie. Pero a medida que empieza a descubrir la verdad sobre el caso, también sale a la luz una peligrosa red de mentiras y engaños que la ponen cada vez más en peligo.

programme.title: Oro
programme.desc: El gerente de una mina de oro de Sudáfrica descubre un complot tramado por los propietarios de la mina y los banqueros de Londres para inundar la mina con el fin de frenar la producción de oro y, en consecuencia, manipular su precio en los mercados de valores.

programme.title: Principiantes
programme.desc: Londres, 1958. Colin es un fotógrafo joven que está perdidamente enamorado de la modelo Crepe Suzette, pero sus relaciones están estrictamente relacionadas con el mundo de la moda. Así que Colin se involucra con un promotor pop y trata de triunfar en la música. Mientras tanto, la tensión racial aumenta en Notting Hill.

programme.title: Viva la muerte
programme.desc: Al final de la Guerra Civil Española, Fando, un niño de diez años, intenta encontrarle sentido a la guerra y a la detención de su padre. Su madre es religiosa y simpatizante de los fascistas, y su padre fue acusado de ser rojo. Fando, que tiene sentimientos edípicos hacia su madre, descubre que ella podría haber colaborado en la detención de su padre.

programme.title: Nostalgia
programme.desc: Un poeta ruso y su intérprete viajan a Italia para investigar la vida de un compositor del siglo XVIII.

programme.title: Juzgado a la italiana
programme.desc: En un día cualquiera, el magistrado Salomone Lo Russo tiene que lidiar con los casos más dispares: delincuentes comunes, crimin…

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: Escrita y dirigida por Woody Allen. Un atormentado profesor de Filosofía (Joaquin Phoenix) encuentra las ganas de vivir cuando comete un acto existencial junto a su amiga y alumna (Emma Stone).

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: El experimento de un profesor de instituto para demostrar a sus alumnos cómo es la vida bajo una dictadura se descontrola terriblemente cuando forma una unidad social con vida propia.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal protagoniza este thriller de acción sobre un hombre que despierta en el cuerpo de otro hombre para descubrir que solo él tiene la capacidad de detener un ataque terrorista en un tren de cercanías.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott regresa a casa en Woodsboro. Pero su vuelta traerá también a su viejo enemigo: Ghostface.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Directores y actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York y narran historias de amor.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado Hachiko
programme.desc: La historia de amistad entre un profesor y Hachi, el perro de raza Akita que recoge perdido en una estación.

programme.title: Mine
programme.desc: Tras una misión fallida, un soldado (Armie Hammer) se encuentra perdido en el desierto. Expuesto a los elementos, tendrá que sobrevivir a los peligros que le acechan, a la vez que hacer frente a los efectos psicológicos de tan penosa situación.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado. Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película sigue la leal amistad entre un profesor y su perro Akita. Hachi espera en la estación, incluso cuando su dueño ya no regresa.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Zona de caza
programme.desc: Una madre huye de su marido mafioso y de sus peligrosos sicarios que intentan darle caza. Desesperada por encontrar un escondite para ella y sus hijos, se refugia en la cabaña del bosque de un excursionista llamado Jake.

programme.title: Tránsito
programme.desc: Historia de suspense de un psiquiatra de Nueva York que intenta detener el suicidio planeado de un joven paciente inusual en la víspera de su 21 cumpleaños.

programme.title: Fremont
programme.desc: Comedia dramática con una historia llena humanidad y optimismo. Donya es una ex traductora afgana del gobierno de Estados Unidos que ahora vive sola en Fremont, California.

programme.title: Decisión final
programme.desc: El día del sorteo de la NFL, el director general Sonny Weaver (Costner) tiene la oportunidad de salvar el fútbol americano en Cleveland al negociar la primera selección.

programme.title: Un atardecer en la Toscana
programme.desc: La ganadora del Premio Nobel, Maria Linde (Krystyna Janda), una mujer de espíritu libre que vive junto a su familia en la cálida Toscana, mantiene un affaire con un joven egipcio dueño de un hotel de la playa cercana.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: Historia romántica teñida de crimen que te mantiene al borde del asiento. Baron (Joe Keery), recientemente encarcelado, entabla amistad con su compañero de celda Otis (Aldis Hodge), un hombre con un amplio historial de fugas de prisión.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: Mi Hostal Navideño
programme.desc: Jennifer es una ejecutiva cuyos padres deciden pasar la Navidad sin ella, decide dejar San Francisco y visitar el hostal que heredó de su abuela en Alaska para arreglarlo y venderlo.

programme.title: Siete días y una vida
programme.desc: El mundo perfecto de una bella reportera de televisión Seattle queda desmoronado por la predicción de su muerte en siete días.

programme.title: Abajo el amor
programme.desc: Nueva York, 1962. Barbara Novak es una escritora feminista cuyo libro "Abajo el amor", se ha convertido en la guía que siguen las mujeres de todo el mundo. Convencido de que Novak es un fraude, el reportero estrella de una revista masculina intenta desenmascararla, haciendo que se enamore de él...

programme.title: Señor y Señora Adelman
programme.desc: Sarah y Victor llevan juntos más de 45 años. ¿Cómo lo han conseguido? ¿Quién es en realidad Sarah, esa enigmática mujer que ha estado siempre a la sombra de su marido? El amor, la ambición y los secretos alimentan la odisea de esta pareja poco corriente.

programme.title: Todas las cosas buenas
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real sucedida en Nueva York en los 80. En los '70, David Marks (Ryan Gosling), el hijo de un gran propietario de bienes inmuebles, se casa con una hermosa estudiante de clase trabajadora, Katie McCarthy (Kirsten Dunst). Tras la boda, se van a vivir al campo, pero bajo la influencia del magnate regresan a la ciudad. Ella vuelve a la facultad de medicina al tiempo que trata de entender los cambios de estado de ánimo de su marido y su falta de voluntad para tener hijos.

programme.title: Una bolsa de canicas
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real. Durante la ocupación nazi en Francia, Maurice y Joseph Joffo son dos hermanos judíos que deben separarse de su familia para evitar su deportación a campos de concentración. Haciendo muestra de gran astucia, coraje e ingenio, intentarán sortear a los soldados alemanes para llegar a la zona libre del sur de Francia y reunirse con los suyos.

programme.title: The Penthouse
programme.desc: En la soleada Carolina Beach, el nuevo ático de Peter y Amanda tiene una vista magnífica del puerto deportivo. Un día observan a una pareja discutiendo a bordo de un velero atracado. Amanda se hace amiga de la asustada Tess, pero poco después desaparece sin dejar rastro.

programme.title: Quisiera que alguien me esperara en algún lugar
programme.desc: Aurore decide celebrar su 70º cumpleaños en su residencia de verano junto a sus 4 hijos. Uno de ellos tomará una decisión que cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Nueve vidas
programme.desc: El cineasta colombiano Rodrigo García vuelve a retratar el mundo femenino mostrando momentos especialmente cruciales y dramáticos en la vida de nueve mujeres, nueve vidas que son prisioneras de relaciones pasadas y presentes.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Ámsterdam
programme.desc: Un misterio épico sobre una sorprendente trama secreta de la historia de EE. UU.

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: Coffee Wars
programme.desc: Una barista vegana se enfrenta al mundo en el Campeonato Mundial de Baristas.

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Contratado para robar el fabuloso diamante Queen, el enano ladrón Calvin Sims (Marlon Wayans) y su tonto compañero Percy (Tracy Morgan) guardan la piedra en la bolsa de mano de Vanessa Edwards (Kerry Washington, Ray) cuando su plan de escape sale mal. Al descubrir al esposo de Vanessa, Darryl (Shawn Wayans), que está desesperado por ser padre, Calvin intercambia sus jugarretas por pañales y se hace pasar por un bebé abandonado. Sufriendo un número de graciosas humillaciones y salidas familiares, Calvin desesperadamente trata de recuperar la gema antes de que lo descubran, y Darryl y Vanessa no están ayudando en nada. Dirigida por Keenen Ivory Wayans (White Chicks).

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Contratado para robar el fabuloso diamante Queen, el enano ladrón Calvin Sims (Marlon Wayans) y su tonto compañero Percy (Tracy Morgan) guardan la piedra en la bolsa de mano de Vanessa Edwards (Kerry Washington, Ray) cuando su plan de escape sale mal. Dirigida por Keenen Ivory Wayans (White Chicks).

programme.title: Paternidad
programme.desc: Kevin Hart protagoniza esta conmovedora historia real sobre un padre viudo que se enfrenta a dudas, miedos, angustias y pañales sucios mientras se dispone a criar a su hija por su cuenta.

programme.title: Duelo al sol
programme.desc: Tras la ejecución de su padre, Pearl se muda con parientes en Texas, donde su belleza desata tensiones. Mientras el senador McCanles la desprecia, su hijo rebelde Lewt se obsesiona con ella, y el noble Jesse intenta protegerla. Los deseos, celos y secretos familiares pronto conducen al desastre.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill en territorio Tomahawk
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill intenta proteger las tierras de los indios de una banda que quiere hacerse con el oro enterrado allí.

programme.title: Ciccio perdona... ¡Yo no!
programme.desc: Los ladrones de caballos Franco y Ciccio roban sin saberlo un carruaje de oro del temido bandido «El Diablo». Perseguidos, acaban convertidos en héroes en el pueblo de Desolación, mientras el astuto forajido planea recuperar su tesoro. Por suerte, dos pistoleras con gran puntería están dispuestas a ayudar al torpe dúo en esta caótica aventura.

programme.title: El Ahorcado
programme.desc: Milagrosamente aún vivo después de su ahorcamiento, el pistolero James Devlin defiende la granja de una joven viuda de un vicioso acaparador de tierras.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un marshal y a un sheriff en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos conocida como Los Sabuesos del Infierno, que han invadido su pequeño pueblo del este de Texas.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y la búsqueda de la tumba de Akhenaten
programme.desc: Jack Hunter es secuestrado por la NSA para buscar la otra parte del arma de Osiris en Giza. Junto a Lena y sus amigos sirios, enfrenta a una secta midianita, a un coronel ambicioso y a peligros mortales mientras descifra pistas ugaríticas hacia el tesoro de la tumba del faraón.

programme.title: Los timadores
programme.desc: Un estafador de poca monta ha roto las lealtades entre su madre separada y su nueva novia, quienes son estafadores de alto riesgo con sus propios ángulos para jugar.

programme.title: Con el mal adentro
programme.desc: Dennis, un hombre con discapacidad mental, comienza a tener pesadillas tras la llegada de un espejo antiguo. Su reflejo lo obliga a matar, convirtiéndolo en un asesino en serie. Mientras tanto, Lydia, la novia de su hermano, se muda con ellos sin ver el peligro.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Traicionado por quienes más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que ahora es el objetivo del sicario más letal del mundo. Sin aliados y contra el reloj, comienza un juego despiadado donde matar primero es la única forma de sobrevivir.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión...

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: Espiando a los detectives
programme.desc: Un cinéfilo aficionado al cine negro en extremo prueba de su propia medicina y ve cómo su vida da un vuelco de la mano de una extraña mujer fatal con una gran aventura en mente. A veces el amor supera a la ficción.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.title: La Hermandad
programme.desc: En un apartado monasterio vive una hermandad de monjes benedictinos. Se ocupan de curar a Sara, una famosa escritora de novelas de terror y misterio, tras un grave accidente. Muy pronto Sara empieza a observar ciertos detalles que llaman su atención.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Creatura
programme.desc: Tras mudarse con su pareja a un nuevo hogar, Mila se da cuenta de que su pérdida de deseo se encuentra en sí misma. A partir de ahí, empieza un viaje en el que revisita experiencias de su infancia y adolescencia con la esperanza de reconciliarse con su propio cuerpo.

programme.title: El Caballero de las Sombras
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de un legendario cazador de demonios (Jackie Chan) que persigue a los monstruos que se adentran en la dimensión de los seres humanos y que cuenta con la ayuda de un abogado y de un grupo de bestias dispuestas a luchar contra el Mal.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: La espada de la venganza
programme.desc: S.XI. Guillermo el Conquistador se proclama rey de Inglaterra provocando una ola de brutales batallas en contra de los rebeldes. Tras años de esclavitud, un príncipe normando, cansado de vivir sometido, decide buscar justicia y vengar el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo.

En tales circunstancias, aparece en su vida un extraño personaje (John Turturro) que lo acusa de haber plagiado uno de sus relatos.

Debe salvar a Estados Unidos de una conspiración letal del general de cinco estrellas y Secretario de Defensa George Deckert (interpretado por Willem Dafoe).
